MISSIONS

"AND THIS GOSPEL OF THE KINGDOM WILL BE PREACHED THROUGHOUT THE WHOLE INHABITED EARTH AS A TESTIMONY TO ALL THE NATIONS, AND THEN THE END WILL COME."
-MATTHEW 24:14

Crosspoint Church is passionate about deploying believers out into the world to make disciples and make Jesus' name famous. Many believers from our congregation are on mission NOW for Christ.

Nolvin Cruz

Lynchburg, Virginia
Nolvin is a local missionary for Cru in Lynchburg, Virginia, and helps disciple students at Liberty University, University of Lynchburg, Randolph College, Central Virginia Community College, and Virginia University of Lynchburg, as well as high school students from E.C. Glass, and Jefferson Forrest High school.

Mitchell Leap

Central Virginia
Mitchell serves as the Central Virginia area representative of FCA and is making disciples of students, athletes, and coaches at the high schools and middle schools in the City of Lynchburg and Amherst County. He also oversees many volunteers that lead bible studies and small group gatherings, along with character coaches who minister to teams at each school.

Pete LoPresto

Virginia
Pete serves as the Virginia Area Director for Man in the Mirror. He is committed to strengthening churches and equipping Christian men in the communities surrounding Lynchburg to engage in meaningful relationships that change lives and build the kingdom of God. As a trained Man in the Mirror consultant, he guides leaders through a comprehensive strategy to reach and disciple men, while providing ongoing support and encouragement every step of the way.

Merve & Valerie Lambright

USA, Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia
Merv and Valerie serve as mobilizers and trainers for Christar, a missions sending agency that focuses on unreached people groups. “Christar comes alongside the Church to mobilize the gospel and to partner with members of the Body of Christ to plant churches where they don’t yet exist.”

Conor & Natalie McAleavey

Northern Ireland
Conor and Natalie serve as missionaries to Northern Ireland through Greater Europe Mission. They focus on multiplying disciples through community engagement and church planting, to bring healing and the hope of Jesus to a historically divided region.

Andre & Estelle
Weideman

South Africa
Andre serves as a disciple-making missionary to the one-percent world of motorcycle clubs, where he uses his influence love for Jesus to spread the good news in a way only a few are called to live.

Becca Miller

Czech Republic
Becca works as a teacher at the Christian International School of Prague  where she is ministering to students from all over the world who come to receive good education. The Lord has blessed her with the opportunity to be a witness for Jesus to students and children who come from families that worship other gods. She has seen the Lord move in many hearts of her students to come to know Jesus!

Courtney Seiler

Middle East
Courtney travels twice a year into the same area to serve and minister to and alongside the refugees in the communities. Days are spent prayer walking, encountering people of peace, and going into the homes of refugees to meet physical needs and share stories and the love of Jesus. Her trips are focused on short-term missions with long-term investment!

Bost Family

Lesotho
We will be serving in the country of Lesotho in Southern Africa with Mission Aviation Fellowship. I will be a pilot/mechanic, flying small aircraft to isolated villages in the mountains of Lesotho. We will be partnering with other missionary, medical, and humanitarian organizations to bring help, hope, and healing to isolated people in order to see them changed by the love of Christ.
